# Tiferes — Native Critique and Safeguards

The Awtsmoos joins Chesed and Gevurah until motion and measure rhyme;
Awtsmoos.com should feel obvious on first touch and inexhaustible over time.

## Thirty safeguards

1. Preserve canonical route IDs.
2. Preserve hash/history semantics.
3. Preserve public exports of shared social primitives.
4. Preserve existing action descriptor fields.
5. Keep disabled actions truly disabled.
6. Keep deep links as anchors.
7. Keep mutations delegated to handler maps.
8. Keep secondary actions reachable at 320px.
9. Restore focus after closing overflow.
10. Keep native `details` semantics.
11. Expose expanded state through data/ARIA where relevant.
12. Avoid layout-shifting active states.
13. Restrict hover affordances to hover-capable devices.
14. Add `:focus-visible` everywhere interactive.
15. Add reduced-motion fallbacks.
16. Add forced-colors resilience.
17. Keep safe-area aware mobile spacing.
18. Avoid horizontal overflow from grid/flex children.
19. Keep z layers finite and documented.
20. Do not attach duplicate listeners on repeated mounts.
21. Keep async action failures visible but non-destructive.
22. Never swallow exact errors before evidence layers can inspect them.
23. Keep discovery separate from execution.
24. Keep DOM creation safe through `textContent`.
25. Keep touched files small by extracting responsibilities.
26. Use tabs in executable code.
27. Re-read every touched file after writes.
28. Run syntax/tests only after the coherent code tranche is complete.
29. Browser-verify narrow mobile and desktop.
30. Compare planned versus actual and convert every delta into remaining work.
